challenge.method: Reconstruct the source's no-argument, positional, reversed named and partially defaulted examples and check receiver order from the preceding paragraph.
challenge.results: Argument side-effect order follows written order even when named arguments map to different parameter positions. Declared order applies to used defaults after supplied arguments.
